item.title: Amiga 1000: Ten years ahead of its time
item.description:
📝 It was multitasking that put the Amiga on the map. The only thing Windows NT did that the Amiga didn’t was memory protection. But that was largely because early Amiga software wasn’t very well written.
🔗 Read more: https://dfarq.homeip.net/amiga-1000-ten-years-ahead-of-its-time/
